/* cppi::79311b18cca57a4e588c6ac2f2ca35bd87ded4f0fb560e54debbd3a35430c905 */
WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-23')               AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE))   AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-23')
          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
          AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_start                         AS "Total Market Value PC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-23')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( 
    with renamed_mp_codes as (
        select
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id,
            business_date,
            row_number() over ( partition by scd_model_portfolio_primary_key order by business_date desc ) new_to_old_rank
        from 
            (
                -- Goal is to keep only the latest record of each MP code
                select 
                    scd_model_portfolio_primary_key, 
                    model_portfolio_id, 
                    replace( business_date, '-', '' ) business_date,
                    row_number() over ( partition by model_portfolio_id order by business_date desc ) rownum
                from reference.scd_model_portfolio 
                where scd_model_portfolio_primary_key in 
                    (
                        -- Get unique MP primary keys that have more than one MP code associated with it
                        select scd_model_portfolio_primary_key --, min( model_portfolio_id ) oldest_mp, max( model_portfolio_id ) newest_mp, count( distinct model_portfolio_id) rename_count
                        from reference.scd_model_portfolio 
                        where business_date > '2024-01-01'
                        group by scd_model_portfolio_primary_key 
                        having count( distinct model_portfolio_id ) > 1
                    )
            ) mp_codes_with_row_number
        where 
            rownum = 1
    ),
    new_mp_list as (
        select 
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id
        from renamed_mp_codes
        where new_to_old_rank = 1
    ),
    old_mp_list as (
        select 
            scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
            model_portfolio_id,
            business_date renamed_date
        from renamed_mp_codes
        where new_to_old_rank > 1
    )
    select 
        n.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key,
        o.model_portfolio_id model_portfolio_code_original,	
        n.model_portfolio_id model_portfolio_code_new,
        renamed_date 
    from new_mp_list n
    join old_mp_list o on n.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key = o.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key
    order by renamed_date     
 ) t

/* QuickSight 3ce805c5-50c4-4b69-811b-5a9c8ac08278 */
SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "business_date_int", "year_month", "period_sorted"
FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), asset_class_clean as (
	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'

		spif.investmentstructurelevel2 as investment_structure_level_02,
		uppcc.epm_party_name as ultimate_parent_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name as issuer_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name /*as "Exposure Via"*/,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc

		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug

				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite secc

		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id

		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,

with lt_base as (

		, mhl.id_model_portfolio
		, mhl.pool_name_unified as pool_name
		, mhl.security_name
		, mhl.total_market_value_pc
		, unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
		, unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.bcpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified LIKE '%bCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end bcpp_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.pool_name_unified in ( 'Core', 'Supplementary' ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc * unitization.acpp_unitized_percentage
			when mhl.pool_name_unified LIKE '%aCPP%' then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end acpp_total_market_value_pc
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_code
		, mhl.parent_quoted_currency_name
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.currency_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_code
		, mhl.country_of_exposure_name
		, mhl.parent_security_number
		, mhl.external_reporting_dm_em
		, mhl.external_reporting_region
		, mhl.external_reporting_country
		, mhl.external_reporting_assetmix
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 as investment_structure_level_01
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2 as investment_structure_level_02
	from (
		select
			*
			, case -- per request of Doug to use special handling to make pool names consistent over history in short term until they have a long-term fix
				when pool_name in ( 'Core', 'Core Pool' ) then 'Core'
				when pool_name in ( 'Supplementary', 'Supplementary Pool' ) then 'Supplementary'
				else pool_name
			  end pool_name_unified
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
	) mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	/* MAP TO ACPP BCPP UNITIZATION */
	left join (
		select
			  business_date 
			, case
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' then 'Core'
				when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 'Supplementary'
			  end pool_name
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'BCPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 0
			  	end ) bcpp_unitized_percentage
			, sum(
				case
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'CORE' and acpp_bcpp_account_code = 'ACPP' then unitized_percentage
					when unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code = 'SUPP' then 1
			  	end
			  ) acpp_unitized_percentage
		from (
			select
				unitization.*
			from (
				select
					  business_date 
					, max( extract_time ) as latest_extract_time -- select only the latest extract times per business date, then join to data table to get latest records only
				from 
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization 
				group by 
					business_date
			) dates
			left join (
				select distinct -- select distinct records only in case there are duplicates
					  business_date
					, extract_time
					, acpp_bcpp_account_code
					, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
					, unitized_percentage
				from
					finance_accounting.scd_unitization
			) unitization
			on
				dates.business_date = unitization.business_date
				and dates.latest_extract_time = unitization.extract_time
		) 
		where
			unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code in ( 'CORE', 'SUPP' )
		group by 
			  business_date 
			, unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code 
	) unitization
		on mhl.business_date = cast( unitization.business_date as date )
		and mhl.pool_name_unified = unitization.pool_name

		and mhl.id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded

                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency

    listed_re_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                 OR model_portfolio IN ('')
            )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-05-21')
    ),

    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2025-05-21')
    ),

    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    )

SELECT
    trans.trade_date                        AS "Trade Date",
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                 AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    trans.abor_security_name                AS "Security Name - Current",
    trans.abor_security_id                  AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    trans.model_portfolio_id                AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    trans.business_transaction_code         AS "Business Transaction Code",
    fin.gl_account_name                     AS "Finance Account Name",
    fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency    AS "Finance Trans. - Credit Amount PC",
    fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS "Finance Trans. - Debit Amount PC",
    fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency    AS "Finance Trans. - Credit Amount QC",
    fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS "Finance Trans. - Debit Amount QC"
FROM latest_trans trans
INNER JOIN latest_finance_trans fin
        ON trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key = fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key
INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp
        ON trans.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
       AND trans.trade_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
      AND trans.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
WHERE trans.rn = 1
  AND fin.rn = 1
ORDER BY trade_date DESC,
         bloomberg_unique_id,
         business_transaction_code,
         gl_account_name

SELECT

   r.country_code,
   p.public_or_private,
   SUM( p.market_value_pc ) AS market_value_pc
FROM
(

SELECT
    h.model_portfolio_id as model_portfolio,
    h.market_value_net_base as market_value_pc,
    i.country_of_exposure as country_of_exposure_cd,
    s.private_public as public_or_private
FROM holdings.ci_sentry_holdings h,
    reference.ci_sentry_security s,
    reference.ci_sentry_issuer i
where (h.security_identifier = s.security_identifier) and (h.loan_contract_identifier IS NULL) and
    (s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier) and (h.business_date BETWEEN s.start_date and s.end_date) and
    (h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date AND i.end_date) and h.business_date = ( select max(business_date) from
    holdings.ci_sentry_holdings where business_date <= '2025-06-03' )

Union all

SELECT
    a.model_portfolio_id as model_portfolio,
    b.carrying_value_base_cur as market_value_pc,
    b.country_of_exposure_source as country_of_exposure_cd,
    b.public_or_private
FROM alternative_assets.investran_private_equity_deals a
join alternative_assets.investran_private_equity_positions b on 
   cast(a.investran_deal_id as varchar) = cast(b.investran_deal_id as varchar)
where a.business_date = (select max(business_date) from alternative_assets.investran_private_equity_deals 
                         where business_date <= date'2025-06-03')
and b.business_date = (select max(business_date) from alternative_assets.investran_private_equity_positions

select 
current_date as extractDate,
current_timestamp as extractTime,
scdh.business_date as businessDate,
(cast(smp.scd_model_portfolio_primary_key as varchar)  || (case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID'
	else 'TRADE_REF'
end) || case
	when mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.parent_cppib_sec_id
	else cast(scdh.abor_security_number as varchar) 
end ) as ID_enterpriseHolding,
scdh.portfolio_id as ID_portfolio,
mhl.id_model_portfolio as ID_modelPortfolio,
cast(scdh.abor_security_number as varchar) as ID_instrument, 
'TRADE_REF' as instrumentIDType, 
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then mhl.cppib_sec_id
	else cast(scdh.abor_security_number as varchar)
end as ID_holdingDecomposition,
case
	when mhl.cppib_sec_id  not in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then 'CPPIBSEC_ID' 
	else 'SECURITY_NO'
end as holdingDecompositionIDTypeCode, 
scdh.scd_holding_key_id as TBT_HOLDINGKEY,
NULL as INSTRUMENTGROUPCODE,
scdh.abor_instrument_type as INSTRUMENTGROUPNAME,
scdh.security_group_id as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPCODE,
scdh.security_group_name as INSTRUMENTSUBGROUPNAME,
scdh.abor_security_type_id as INSTRUMENTTYPECODE,
scdh.abor_security_type_name as INSTRUMENTTYPENAME,
scdh.abor_security_name as INSTRUMENTNAMESOURCE,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' then scdh.abor_security_name else mhl.security_name end) as underlyingInstrumentNameSource,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' then scdh.abor_security_type_id 
      when mhl.holding_level <> 'Look Through' then NULL
--      else COALESCE(scds2.abor_security_type_id,COALESCE(mhl.security_type_name,scds.abor_security_type_id)) end) as underlyingInstrumentTypeCode,
      else COALESCE(scds3.abor_security_type_id,COALESCE(scds2.scd_sec_type,COALESCE(mhl.security_type_name,scds.abor_security_type_id))) end) as underlyingInstrumentTypeCode,
scdh.balance_nominal_number as quantity,
scdh.clean_price as currentPrice,
mhl.balance_nominal as underlyingQuantity,
mdsprice.current_price as underlyingPrice,
(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) as marketValue,
scdh.quotation_currency_code as quotedCurrencyCode,
scdh.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as fxRateQuotedInCAD,
(sum(case when mhl.leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_pc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id)) as marketValuePC,
'CAD' as portfoliocurrencyCode,
0 as faceValue,
NULL as optionDelta,
(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' or mhl.underlying_index_name in ( 'Not Applicable' , 'Error') then NULL 
		else mhl.underlying_index_name end) as referenceIndex,
upper(mhl.holding_level) as lookthroughLevelType,
abs(case when mhl.holding_level = 'Top Level' THEN 1
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and --mhl.leg_no = 1 and 
           (sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) ) <> 0
           then
              mhl.total_market_value_qc/(sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) )
           when mhl.holding_level = 'Look Through' and --mhl.leg_no = 1 and 
           (sum(case when leg_no = 1 and holding_level = 'Look Through' then mhl.total_market_value_qc else 0 end) over(partition by scdh.scd_holding_key_id) ) = 0
           then 1
           else null end) as  underlyingWeight
, mhl.leg_no, mhl.total_market_value_qc
from holdings.scd_holdings_main scdh
join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp on smp.business_date  = scdh.business_date  and smp.model_portfolio_id = scdh.model_portfolio_id 
join holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended mhl on  mhl.business_Date  = cast(scdh.business_Date as date) and scdh.scd_holding_key_id = mhl.parent_holding_key
left outer join reference.scd_securities scds on scdh.business_Date = scds.business_Date and scdh.abor_security_number =  scds.abor_security_number
left outer join reference.scd_securities scds3 on scdh.business_Date = scds3.business_Date and  cast(mhl.cppib_sec_id as varchar) =  scds3.cppib_sec_id
left outer join asset.asset_security_identifiers scds2 on mhl.business_Date  = scds2.business_Date and  mhl.cppib_sec_id =  cast(scds2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
left outer join mdsprice on --mdsprice.business_Date = mhl.business_Date and 
    mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(mdsprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar) and trim(upper(mdsprice.currency_code)) = trim(upper(scdh.quotation_currency_code))
--left outer join indxconstprice on mhl.cppib_sec_id = cast(indxconstprice.cppib_sec_id as varchar)
where scdh.business_Date = '2025-05-27'  
and portfolio_calculation_id = 'RISK METRICS_DAILY'
and portfolio_group_id = 'CPPIB GROUP'
and upper(trim(scdh.abor_security_type_id)) in ('TRSEQIC', 'TRSILB', 'TRSFIIC', 'TRSEQ') 
and scdh.abor_security_name = 'CGS240222AT2'
and /* exclude zero-balance holdings */
NOT
(
COALESCE(scdh.clean_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number,0) =0 and
COALESCE(scdh.accrued_interest_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_dividend_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,0) = 0 and
COALESCE(scdh.next_coupon_quotation_currency,0) = 0 
)
order by scdh.scd_holding_key_id

	client_ip

  reference.sector,

  --------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------
  staging.funding_currency,
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'
  END AS deployment_disposition,
  COALESCE(staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm, 0) * (COALESCE(staging.probability_of_close, 0) / 100.0) AS probability_weighted_investment_amount_local,

  staging.market_value,
  staging.portfolio_name,
  staging.sentry_security_type,
  staging.price_multiplier,
  staging.quantity_multiplier,
  staging.debt_factor,
  staging.model_portfolio_id,
  --------------------------------------

  --------------------------------------
  CASE
    WHEN staging.expected_exit_probability IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(staging.expected_exit_date AS DATE) > CAST(staging.business_date AS DATE)

    WHEN staging.expected_exit_probability IS NULL

    WHEN staging.expected_full_funding_amt_deal_currency_mm >= 0 THEN 'Deployment'
    ELSE 'Disposition'

            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency

            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates

          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 04:48:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::b72edf9545324bce79dd9bcc0051bff9bdba1ddf1d841d902956f1d85c4756a4 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 10:50:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 20:36:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

with hedge_ratio_src as (
	select case
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0 then f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy = 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy != 0 then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy else f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
		end hedge_pv,
		coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * coalesce(dpi.local_currency_fcp, 0) as fcp_base,
		dpi.long_short,
		h.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	from risk_uat.dim_pos_inst dpi
		join risk_uat.fact_pos_calc_sd f on f.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
		and dpi.business_date = f.business_date
		join risk_uat.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id
		and dpi.business_date = h.business_date
		left join risk_uat.fact_fx_rate fx ON dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
		and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
	where dpi.business_date = '2025-06-03'
		and dpi.portfolio_Type = 'IP'
		and (
			dpi.maturity_date is null
			or to_date(dpi.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= dpi.maturity_date
		)
		 AND  h.investment_strat in ('Europe')
		 and not (  dpi.security_group_name in ('Call Money Funding Services', 'Cash Bucket', 'Cost', 'Internal Funding Source and Loans', 'FX Non Deliverable Forward', 'Pooled Fund Private Equity', 'Private Debt Direct', 'Private Equity Direct'))
),
hedge_ratio_short_long as (
	select sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'LONG' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as long_hedge_pv,
		sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'SHORT' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as short_hedge_pv,
		sum(fcp_base) fcp_base_pv,
		'Y' subtruct_fcp
	from hedge_ratio_src a
)
select 'AE_EU_SMD_HEDGERATIO_PCT_B' as LIMIT_NAME,
	case
		when subtruct_fcp = 'Y' then coalesce(abs((short_hedge_pv - fcp_base_pv) / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
		when subtruct_fcp = 'N' then coalesce(abs(short_hedge_pv / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
	end as MEASURE_VALUE
  from hedge_ratio_short_long a

/* cppi::b9978d3bb774bb4b47cc555159c8252378cee30d463ff65245387abddb58c654 */
SELECT *
        FROM (
		    SELECT
		        currencyCode,
			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,
								erc.is_exchange_holiday_flag as holiday_flag
						FROM cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad erc
								LEFT JOIN cppib_market_exchange_rate erd
								ON erc.data_date = erd.data_date
								AND erc.vendor = erd.vendor
								AND erc.currency = erd.currency

			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 04 and 05
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 04:20:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

            from_currency as from_currency,
            to_currency as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end,6) as mid_price,
            business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
        WHERE
            from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD'
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            and business_date = Date('2025-06-04')
        UNION
        Select
            MainTable.to_currency as from_currency,
            'CAD' as to_currency,
            ROUND(case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then
                MainTable.mid_price * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                else (1/MainTable.mid_price) * CAD_Rate.mid_price
                end,6) as calc_mid_price,
            MainTable.business_date
        FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr as MainTable
        Left Join
        (
            SELECT
                case
                when UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' Then 1/mid_price
                else mid_price
                end as mid_price,
                business_date
            FROM refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
            WHERE from_currency = 'USD' and to_currency = 'CAD' and business_date = Date('2025-06-04')
            and source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
        ) as CAD_Rate on
            MainTable.business_date = CAD_Rate.business_date
        WHERE
            MainTable.business_date = Date('2025-06-04')
            and MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
            and MainTable.mid_price != 0
            and MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
            order by business_date,from_currency

 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 03 and 04
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 03:45:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 11:40:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

                         ELSE query_date - interval '1' day

                     query_date AS original_date

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
            SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
        ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

with hedge_ratio_src as (
	select case
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0 then f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy = 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy != 0 then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy else f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
		end hedge_pv,
		coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * coalesce(dpi.local_currency_fcp, 0) as fcp_base,
		dpi.long_short,
		h.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	from risk_prod.dim_pos_inst dpi
		join risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd f on f.pos_id = dpi.pos_id
		and dpi.business_date = f.business_date
		join risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id
		and dpi.business_date = h.business_date
		left join risk_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
		and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
	where dpi.business_date = '2025-06-03'
		and dpi.portfolio_Type = 'IP'
		and (
			dpi.maturity_date is null
			or to_date(dpi.business_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') <= dpi.maturity_date
		)
		 AND  h.program in ('Latin America Public Investments', 'Latin America Hedge Overlay')
		 and not (  dpi.security_group_name in ('Call Money Funding Services', 'Cash Bucket', 'Cost', 'Internal Funding Source and Loans', 'FX Non Deliverable Forward', 'FX Forward', 'Private Equity Direct', 'Right'))
),
hedge_ratio_short_long as (
	select sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'LONG' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as long_hedge_pv,
		sum(
			case
				when long_short = 'SHORT' then hedge_pv else 0
			end
		) as short_hedge_pv,
		sum(fcp_base) fcp_base_pv,
		'Y' subtruct_fcp
	from hedge_ratio_src a
)
select 'AE_DEILA_SMD_EXPR_HEDGERATIO_PCT_B' as LIMIT_NAME,
	case
		when subtruct_fcp = 'Y' then coalesce(abs((short_hedge_pv - fcp_base_pv) / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
		when subtruct_fcp = 'N' then coalesce(abs(short_hedge_pv / long_hedge_pv), 0) * 100
	end as MEASURE_VALUE
  from hedge_ratio_short_long a

        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Direct Private Equity (S)~CORE' THEN 'Direct Private Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Private Equity Asia~CORE' THEN 'Private Equity Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Growth Equity (P)~CORE' THEN 'Growth Equity'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'Listed Real Estate~CORE' THEN 'Listed Real Estate'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy PE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Growth Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE GE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy DEILA~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE DEILA'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy FIG~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE FIG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Funds & Secondaries~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE F&S'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy SEG~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA SEG'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy AE Asia~CORE' THEN 'ISG AE Asia'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy Direct Private Equity~CORE' THEN 'ISG PE DPE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy RE~CORE' THEN 'ISG RA RE'
        WHEN a.hierarchy_node = 'ISG Legacy~CORE' THEN 'ISG Legacy'
        ELSE a.hierarchy_node
    END AS hierarchy_node,
    
    CAST(a.business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,

    -- Fiscal Quarter Tagging
    CASE
        WHEN a.business_date IN (
            SELECT MAX(business_date)
            FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_vol
            WHERE month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (3,6,9,12)
              AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') < date_trunc('month', current_date)
            GROUP BY year(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')), month(date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d'))
        )
        THEN CASE
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (4,5,6)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q1'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (7,8,9)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q2'
            WHEN month(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) IN (10,11,12)
                THEN 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) + 1 AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q3'
            ELSE 'F' || substr(cast(year(date_parse(a.business_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS varchar), 3, 2) || ' Q4'
        END
        ELSE NULL
    END AS fiscal_quarter,

    a.analytic_value AS active_vol_10yr,  
    b.pv, 
    CASE 
        WHEN b.pv IS NOT NULL AND b.pv != 0 THEN a.analytic_value / b.pv 
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS active_vol_number,
    
    TRY_CAST(beta.analytic_value AS DOUBLE) AS TenYr_Beta

    AND CAST(b.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

    LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node d

        AND d.business_date = c.business_date
    WHERE c.portfolio_type_2 = 'SAP CORE'
      AND c.analytic_name = '10 Year Beta'

    ON a.hierarchy_node = beta.node_name
    AND CAST(beta.business_date AS DATE) = CAST(a.business_date AS DATE)

-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.

-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.

-- This query retrieves holdings data and joins it with coupon and security-level
-- metadata. It filters the results based on selected asset types and seniorities,
-- and enriches each record with maturity dates and expected exit information.
-- The data is sourced as-of the latest available business date for accurate and
-- timely reporting.
--
-- Acronyms:
--   ABS   : Asset-Backed Security
--   CLO   : Collateralized Loan Obligation
--   CMBS  : Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities
--   NPL   : Non-Performing Loan
--   HRR   : High-Risk Rated
--
-- Data Lineage Summary:
--   Security Metadata: reference.ci_sentry_security
--     (Reference - asset type, seniority, etc.)
--   Coupon Metadata:   reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon
--     (Reference - maturity dates and coupon terms)
--
-- Parameters:
--   business_date : Latest business date available in ci_sentry_security.
--
-- v1.0.1 | 2025-04-09 | kbaxter@cppib.com
--   - Initial creation: joins holdings with security and coupon metadata,
--     includes filters for asset type and seniority, and applies latest
--     business date.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--     an issuer.
--   - Removed the PARAMS CTE
--   - Added handling for table replacement by environment
--   - Added cppib_security_id to the misc section.
--   - Corrected the field name inv_sub_strategy
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.1.1 | 2025-04-29 | kbaxter@cppib.com

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- v1.2.0 | 2025-05-22 | gstoffer@cppib.com

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

WITH

eligible_securities AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security
    WHERE sentry_security_type NOT IN ('rateIndex', 'loanContract', 'creditAgreement')
      AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-02' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-03' AS DATE) >= CAST(start_date AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-03' AS DATE) <= CAST(end_date AS DATE)
),

inv_group_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'CS'    AS inv_group, 'Capital Solutions'    AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC'    AS inv_group, 'European Credit'      AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC'   AS inv_group, 'Real Assets Credit'   AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC'  AS inv_group, 'APAC Credit'          AS inv_group_long UNION ALL
    SELECT 'PC'    AS inv_group, 'Public Credit'        AS inv_group_long
),

inv_strategy_mapping AS (
    SELECT 'APAC Capital Solutions'             AS inv_strategy, 'Capital Solutions'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC IG Illiquid'                   AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Real Estate Credit'            AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate Credit'             AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'APAC Sponsor Financing'             AS inv_strategy, 'Sponsor Financing'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Antares'                         AS inv_strategy, 'Antares'                        AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Asset Backed'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Asset Backed & Financials'      AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS CLO'                             AS inv_strategy, 'CLO'                            AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Corporates'                      AS inv_strategy, 'Corporates'                     AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS IP & Royalties'                  AS inv_strategy, 'Life Science & IP'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CS Latam'                           AS inv_strategy, 'Latam'                          AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC IG Illiquid'                     AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Corporate Rel Val'               AS inv_strategy, 'Corporate Rel Val'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC NPLs'                            AS inv_strategy, 'NPLs'                           AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'EC Structured Credit'               AS inv_strategy, 'Structured Credit'              AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_strategy, 'IG Illiquid'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Infrastructure'                 AS inv_strategy, 'Infrastructure'                 AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Real Estate'                    AS inv_strategy, 'Real Estate'                    AS inv_sub_strategy_override UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RAC Sustainable Energies Credit'    AS inv_strategy, 'Sustainable Energies'           AS inv_sub_strategy_override
),

coupon_list AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        coupon.business_date,
        coupon.security_identifier,
        coupon.sentry_security_type,
        CASE
            WHEN coupon.sentry_security_type IN (
                'delayedDrawFacility',
                'revolvingCreditFacility',
                'termLoanFacility'
            ) THEN coupon.facility_maturity_date
            ELSE coupon.colc_maturity_date
        END AS maturity_date
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon AS coupon
    WHERE CAST(coupon.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-03' AS DATE)
),

issuer_list AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer AS issuer
    WHERE CAST(issuer.business_date AS DATE) = CAST('2025-06-03' AS DATE)
      AND CAST('2025-06-03' AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(issuer.start_date AS DATE) AND CAST(issuer.end_date AS DATE)
)

    'Sentry Reference'                           AS source
   , '2025-06-03'                           AS business_date
   , 'df4c633f-9d41-467d-b921-556cf7ea27ef'                                  AS run_id

   , CAST(NULLIF(SEC.expected_exit_price, '')    AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS expected_exit_price

   , NULL                                        AS pec_recusals

   , NULL                                        AS full_amt_cad_mm
   , NULL                                        AS rejected_deals_reason
   , NULL                                        AS investment_program
   , NULL                                        AS investment_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS investment_group
   , NULL                                        AS tfm_inv_sub_strategy
   , NULL                                        AS comment
   , NULL                                        AS error
   , 'reference_dev.ci_sentry_security, reference_dev.ci_sentry_security_coupon, reference_dev.ci_sentry_issuer'
                                                 AS data_sources_list
   , SEC.business_date                           AS security_src_business_date
   , COUP.business_date                          AS coupon_src_business_date
   , ISSUER.business_date                        AS issuer_src_business_date
   , NULL                                        AS dc_opportunity_id                  -- TODO

FROM eligible_securities        AS SEC
LEFT JOIN issuer_list           AS ISSUER            ON SEC.issuer_identifier     = ISSUER.issuer_identifier
LEFT JOIN inv_group_mapping     AS INV_GROUP_MAP     ON SEC.inv_group             = INV_GROUP_MAP.inv_group
LEFT JOIN inv_strategy_mapping  AS INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP ON SEC.inv_strategy          = INV_SUB_STRAT_MAP.inv_strategy
LEFT JOIN coupon_list           AS COUP              ON SEC.security_identifier   = COUP.security_identifier
                                                    AND SEC.business_date         = COUP.business_date

select --'lcr_deriv_lt_17' src,
date_format(l.business_date, '%d/%m/%Y') "Business_Date"
,rmp.model_portfolio_id "MP_Code"
,pf.investmentstructurelevel1 Node_1_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel2 Node_2_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel3 Node_3_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel4 Node_4_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel5 Node_5_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel6 Node_6_Name
,pf.investmentstructurelevel7 Node_7_Name

,CASE WHEN l.parent_security_name LIKE 'CDS%' THEN 'CDS'
      WHEN l.parent_security_name LIKE 'CRDI%' THEN 'CDX' 
      WHEN l.parent_security_name LIKE 'SCDO%' THEN 'SCDO'
      else m.abor_security_type_name
 end AS "Parent_Security_Type_Name"
,l.parent_security_name as "Parent_Security_Name"
,brk.party_name as "Broker_Name"
,CASE WHEN p.party_name = 'INT_CPPIB' OR p.party_name LIKE 'Internal%' OR p.party_name LIKE 'INTERNAL%' OR p.party_name in ('INT. TRANSFER','Canada Pension Plan Investment Board','INTCLR')
        OR p.party_name LIKE 'INT-%' OR p.party_name LIKE 'INT CROSS%' OR p.party_name LIKE 'INT TRANSFER%' THEN 'Internal'
      else 'External' end as "Internal_External"
,date_format(date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11)),'%d/%m/%Y') AS "Maturity_Date"
,DATE_DIFF('day',l.business_date,date(substr(m.abor_maturity_date,1,11))) AS "Term_To_Maturity"
/*Leg no but need the logic to map*/ 
,CASE 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Equity' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ','TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'IRS IR' THEN
    case when esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' then 'Fixed' else 'Floating' end
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Credit' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF')
AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Base' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT','FXFORWARD','FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Price'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Fixed Income'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Financing' 
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no <> 2 THEN 'Future'
WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Future Offset' 
ELSE NULL END AS Leg_Type

,CASE 
  --IRS
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap floating leg' AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_sec_subtype ='Swap fixed leg' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN 'Short'
  /*
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Fixed' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long' 
  WHEN m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' AND esmv.esm_coupon_type = 'Floating' AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
  */
  --Others
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQ', 'TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long' 
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('CDS') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD',  'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Long'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short'
    WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND', 'FUT_EQT', 'FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
    ELSE NULL
END AS "Contract_Direction"

,CASE WHEN l.total_market_value_pc < 0 THEN 'Short' WHEN l.total_market_value_pc >= 0 THEN 'Long'
      ELSE NULL END AS "Leg_Direction"
,l.underlying_index_name AS "Underlying_Index"

,case when m.abor_security_type_id='IRS IR' then concat(l.parent_security_number,'_1L0',cast(l.leg_no as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 1 THEN concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat('CPP',cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level = 'Look Through' THEN
               concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar),cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar)))
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') AND l.holding_level != 'Look Through' THEN l.parent_security_number
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 1 AND l.cppib_sec_id != 'Not Applicable' THEN concat('CPP',l.cppib_sec_id)
      when m.abor_security_type_id='CDS' AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(l.parent_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.abor_security_number,'-999')
      when m.abor_security_type_name='Equity Future' then concat('CPP',cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))
      else coalesce(esmv.abor_security_number, concat('CPP',coalesce(cast(ai2.cppib_sec_id as varchar), cast(esmv.cppib_sec_id as varchar))))
 end AS "Underlying_Security_No"

,case WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN ('FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT','FUT_IR') AND l.leg_no = 2 THEN concat(esmv.esm_security_name,'-FutureOffset')
      else esmv.esm_security_name
 end AS "Underlying_Security_Name"

,case when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future','Equity Future') then p.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('FXSPOT', 'FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id in ('IRS IR') then spi.party_name
      when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSFIIC') then coalesce(p.party_name, spi.party_name)
      else pc.epm_party_name end AS "Underlying_Issuer_Name"

,m.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency AS "FX_Rate"
,l.balance_nominal "Balance_Nominal"
,CASE WHEN m.abor_security_type_id IN (
        'TRSEQ',
        'TRSEQIC',
        'CDS',
        'FXSPOT',
        'FXFORWARD',
        'FXNDF',
        'TRSFIIC',
        'FUT_BOND',
        'FUT_EQT',
        'FUT_IR',
        'IRS IR'
    )
     THEN l.total_market_value_pc

,case when m.abor_security_type_id IN ('TRSEQIC','TRSFIIC','IRS IR','FUT_IR','FUT_BOND','FUT_EQT')

        else l.currency_of_exposure_code end AS "Currency_Of_Exposure"
,p.cppib_party_id ID_CPPIBPRTY_ISSR
,m.abor_security_type_name Parent_Security_Type_Name_SCD
,rs.abor_instrument_type_id Parent_Instrument_Type_Name
,coalesce(pgc.name, ' ') Underlying_GICS_Lev_2_Name
,coalesce(case when m.abor_security_type_name in (
     'Credit Default Swap'
     ) then
           date_format(date(und_esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
     when m.abor_security_type_name in ('Bond Future', 'TRS Fixed Income IC') AND l.leg_no <> 2 then
          date_format(date(esmv.esm_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y')
      else date_format(date(m.abor_maturity_date),'%d/%m/%Y') end,' ')  Und_Maturity_Date

from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough_extended l
left join holdings.scd_holdings_main m

left join reference.scd_securities rs

		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 04
		AND hour between 13 and 14
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-04 13:51:23'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::5887affb235e5360d49bdbe7ec0160f07f4c3948684b527d9c95fd8e17dc7a0b */
WITH boundary_dates AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_date <= DATE '2007-04-08' THEN business_date END) AS lower_bound,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_date <= DATE '2025-09-18' THEN business_date END) AS upper_bound
    FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
),
cad_fx AS (
    SELECT 
        from_currency,
        ROUND(CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1 / mid_price 
            ELSE mid_price 
        END, 8) AS mid_price,
        business_date
    FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr r
    JOIN boundary_dates b ON r.business_date BETWEEN b.lower_bound AND b.upper_bound
    WHERE r.from_currency = 'USD'
      AND r.to_currency = 'CAD'
      AND r.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
),
cross_fx AS (
    SELECT 
        MainTable.to_currency AS from_currency,
        ROUND(
            CASE 
                WHEN UPPER(MainTable.inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN MainTable.mid_price * cad.mid_price
                ELSE (1 / MainTable.mid_price) * cad.mid_price
            END, 8
        ) AS calc_mid_price,
        MainTable.business_date
    FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr MainTable
    JOIN boundary_dates b ON MainTable.business_date BETWEEN b.lower_bound AND b.upper_bound
    LEFT JOIN cad_fx cad ON MainTable.business_date = cad.business_date
    WHERE MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
      AND MainTable.mid_price != 0
      AND MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
)
-- Final result
SELECT 
    from_currency,
    format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS business_date,
    mid_price AS fx_rate
FROM cad_fx

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    from_currency,
    format_datetime(business_date, 'yyyyMMdd') AS business_date,
    calc_mid_price AS fx_rate
FROM cross_fx

ORDER BY business_date, from_currency

WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_uat
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP'
    and sd.business_date = dh.business_date
where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-03'
    )
select ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                      as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) as conc_sector_limit,
       case
           when max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit) > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                     (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) *
                                                                     100, 2)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit)) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * max(ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit))
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.gics_sector='Financials' and f.business_date = ule.business_date
         --and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit is not null
		 -- and ule.bcpp_sector_conc_board_limit != -1

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-03'
group by ule.gics_sector, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALP,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number < 0 THEN -1 * h.balance_nominal_number END) AS PFCHOLDINGS_BALNOMVALS,
 t.party_name AS PARTNERS_BROKERNAME,
 t.trade_date AS SECURITIES_ISSDATE,
 h.abor_maturity_date AS PFCKEYRATIOS_MATDATE,
 h.portfolio_id AS PORTFOLIOS_POR,
 MAX(CASE WHEN h.balance_nominal_number >= 0 THEN h.quotation_currency_code ELSE NULL END) AS HOLKEYS_QUOCURP,
 h.security_group_id AS SECGROUPS_SECGRP,

 SUM(h.unrealised_pnl_book_currency_portfolio_currency + h.unrealised_pnl_book_security_portfolio_currency) AS PFCKEYRATIOS_CLEANVALPCT,
 h.portfolio_group_name AS PORTGROUPS_PORGRP
 from holdings.scd_holdings_main h
 JOIN (
 select DISTINCT t.abor_security_id , t.trade_date, p.party_name
 from trades_deals.scd_transactions t
 join reference.scd_party_issuer p on  t.counterparty_id = p.scd_party_id
 where 1=1
 and t.business_transaction_code in ('SellFXFwdDbd','BuyFXFwdDbd','InitHoldNom','InitHold')
 and t.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
 ) t ON h.abor_security_id = t.abor_security_id
 WHERE h.business_date = '2025-06-03'
 and (t.party_name not LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%'
 or (trim(h.portfolio_id) = 'S PARENT' and t.party_name LIKE 'INTERNAL CPTY%'))
 and h.security_group_id in ('FXFORWARD', 'FXNDF')
 and h.balance_nominal_number != 0
 GROUP BY
 h.model_portfolio_id,
 h.abor_security_id,
 t.party_name,
 t.trade_date,
 h.abor_maturity_date,
 h.portfolio_id,
 h.security_group_id,

WITH
    input_dates AS (
        SELECT
            DATE('2025-05-23')                  AS input_date,
            MAX(CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE)) AS prev_trans_date
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) < DATE('2025-05-23')
            AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL
            AND perf.market_value_reporting_currency IS NOT NULL
    ),

    listed_seg_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
            AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
            AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
            AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
            AND (
                        InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Sustainable Energy Group'
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Power and Renewables Group')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Power Generation')
                    AND investmentstructurelevel6 IN ('DM - Power Generation', 'EM - Power Generation')
                    AND InvestmentStructureLevel7 IN ('Listed DM', 'Listed EM')
                    AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('')
                     OR model_portfolio IN ('MPRSBE0','MPR1000279','MPR1000328','MPR1000200','MPAR100041')
                )
            AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )
    ),

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_seg_mp mp
                ON perf.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio
               AND perf.business_date = mp.business_date
        LEFT JOIN holdings.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code
              AND perf.abor_security_number = CONCAT('CPP', CAST(asset.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR))
              AND CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = asset.business_date
        WHERE CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
              )
          AND perf.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit')
        GROUP BY perf.model_portfolio_id,
                 perf.abor_security_id,
                 perf.abor_security_number,
                 mp.model_portfolio,
                 asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
                 asset.security_name,
                 asset.bloomberg_code
    )

SELECT
    (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)                    AS "Start Date",
    perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id                           AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    perf_data.security_name                                 AS "Security Name - Current",
    perf_data.bloomberg_code                                AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    perf_data.model_portfolio                               AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_start                         AS "Total Market Value QC Start",
    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow QC",
    perf_data.market_value_qc_end                           AS "Total Market Value QC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency  AS "Total PnL QC",

    perf_seclvl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency            AS "Net Cash Flow PC",
    perf_data.market_value_pc_end                           AS "Total Market Value PC End",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency - perf_seclvl.period_result_node_by_node_local AS "FX PnL PC",
    perf_seclvl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency  AS "Total PnL PC"
FROM perf_data
INNER JOIN performance.scd_performance_seclvl perf_seclvl
        ON perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_1 = perf_data.model_portfolio
       AND perf_seclvl.aggregation_level_3 = perf_data.bloomberg_code
       AND CAST(perf_seclvl.business_date AS DATE) = DATE('2025-05-23')
ORDER BY perf_data.bloomberg_unique_id,
         perf_data.bloomberg_code
